newsitem.title: GERMANY: KHD customer Fendt renews contract.
newsitem.headline: KHD customer Fendt renews contract.

text.p: Troubled German engineering group Kloeckner-Humboldt-Deutz AG said on Monday its customer Xaver Fendt Gmbh & Co had renewed an engine delivery contract with KHD's Deutz Motor subsidiary.
KHD said in a statement the contract covered delivery by Deutz to Fendt of 50- to 150-horsepower Deutz and Deutz MWM diesel engines into the next century.
Fendt has bought 485,000 Deutz engines over the last 48 years to power tractors and stationary machines.
KHD holds its annual shareholders meeting on Tuesday.
